title: /loop command returns 'Unknown skill: loop' in CLI v2.1.71
body:
## Description

The `/loop` command, added in v2.1.71, does not work in the CLI. It returns `Unknown skill: loop` instead of executing.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Install Claude Code CLI v2.1.71
2. Run `/loop 1m hello` (or any `/loop` command)
3. Observe error: `Unknown skill: loop`

## Expected behavior

`/loop 5m check the deploy` should run the given prompt on a recurring 5-minute interval, as described in the [2.1.71 changelog](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases).

## Actual behavior

```
❯ /loop 1m hello
Unknown skill: loop
```

The command appears to be routed through the skill system rather than being recognized as a built-in slash command.

## Environment

- Claude Code version: 2.1.71
- Platform: macOS (Darwin 25.3.0)
- Shell: zsh
